title: [Enhancement] Support multi-selection Enter key to open multiple connections in Connection Tree
author: julesbobb
body_snippet:
## Summary

When multiple connections are selected in the Connection Tree and **Enter** is pressed, no connections are opened. This is a feature gap — the Enter key handler was written for single-selection only and does not account for multi-selection.

---

## Type

**Enhancement / Feature Request**

---

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Open the **Connection Tree**.
2. Select multiple connections using **Shift+Arrow** (sequential) or **Ctrl+Click** (non-sequential).
3. Press **Enter**.
